title.narrative: Think and Do Tank in Support of Accelerating Resilience Building in the ASALs of Kenya

description.narrative: The Resilience Think and Do Tank (RTDT) is a three-year program (2024–2027) funded by the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Kenya and implemented by the Millennium Water Alliance, VNG International, and Akvo Kenya Foundation. It focuses on catalyzing investments in Kenya’s Arid and Semi-Arid Lands (ASALs), regions with untapped potential for climate-smart agri-food development. The program generates reliable data on investment opportunities across food crop, fodder, livestock, and fish value chains, and shares this knowledge through conventions, investment forums, and a digital repository and interaction platform that connects investors with viable ventures. RTDT also works to strengthen the enabling environment for investments. This includes providing technical support to county-level institutions to enhance their capacity in investment brokerage, as well as empowering local communities through training and coaching on social accountability tools. By equipping citizens to participate in decision-making at ward, sub-county, and county levels, the program ensures that investments are inclusive, transparent, and responsive to local needs. Expected outputs include well-developed investment opportunity profiles, high-level investor convenings, stronger county institutions, and empowered communities that can shape development priorities. The program’s ultimate goal is to accelerate agri-food investments and achieve sustainable economic development in Kenya’s ASALs.
